title: A Vector for the Orbit Anew
author: Mirabel Coldharbour
blurb: Juniper Coldharbour, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
